title: IdentityBindingBundle (v1)
description: The `GET /api/v1/identity/:motebitId` response: a motebit's current key, its self-signed succession chain, and — once anchored — a Merkle inclusion proof against an on-chain root. The bundle carries no relay signature by design: the relay is a CDN, not a trust root, and every claim inside is independently verifiable. See spec/identity-v1.md §7.6.

motebit_id.description: The motebit whose binding this describes.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the genesis key became active (registration time).

current_public_key.description: The motebit's CURRENT identity public key (hex) — the head of its chain.

guardian_public_key.description: The guardian public key (hex), when one is registered. REQUIRED to verify a guardian-recovery link — without it a third party cannot check that link and the whole chain fails to verify.

old_public_key.description: The key being replaced (hex-encoded Ed25519 public key).

new_public_key.description: The key taking over (hex-encoded Ed25519 public key).

timestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds when the rotation took effect.

suite.description: Cryptosuite — JCS canonicalization, Ed25519, hex encoding.

old_key_signature.description: Old key's signature over the canonical payload. Present in a normal rotation, ABSENT in a guardian recovery.

new_key_signature.description: New key's signature over the canonical payload. Always present.

recovery.description: True when the rotation was authorized by the guardian, not the old key (§3.8.3).

guardian_signature.description: Guardian's signature — present only when `recovery` is true.

succession.description: The self-signed rotation chain, genesis → current. Empty if never rotated.

index.description: Leaf index of this motebit's binding in the identity log.

layerSizes.description: Node count per tree layer — lets a verifier reconstruct an unbalanced tree.

anchoredRoot.description: The log's Merkle root (hex) — the value the relay posted on-chain.

tree_hash_version.description: RFC 6962 §2.1 tree-hash recipe (`MerkleTreeVersion`). **Absent ⇒ `merkle-sha256-plain-v1`**, so proofs minted before this axis existed stay byte-identical. A verifier resolves an unknown value fail-closed — never a silent downgrade. See docs/doctrine/merkle-tree-hash-versioning.md.

proof.description: Inclusion proof whose `anchoredRoot` the verifier MUST confirm on-chain independently.

network.description: CAIP-2 network identifier of the anchor transaction.

anchored.description: Inclusion proof against the latest CONFIRMED on-chain root, or `null` when this motebit is not yet in a confirmed anchor — an honest state, not an error.
